title: pkg/channel: add test coverage for the channel WriteCloser
body:
`pkg/channel` provides a small `io.WriteCloser` (`writeCloser`) that proxies
each `Write` call onto a `chan []byte` as one message. It currently has no unit
tests despite a few behaviours worth pinning down:

- `Write` queues each buffer as a single channel message and returns `len(b)`.
- `Write` makes a defensive copy, so mutating the caller's slice after `Write`
  does not change the queued message.
- `Write` on a nil receiver returns an error pointing at `channel.NewWriter()`.
- `Close` closes the channel; a subsequent `Write` fails with
  "the channel is closed for Write".

Add table/behaviour unit tests covering these. Pure-Go, no behaviour change,
`go test ./pkg/channel/` passes all
